source_snapshot.items: Health Check on UBB and OAM
source_snapshot.procedure: Load amdgpu, then GET Chassis health for UBB and OAM_0 through OAM_7 over the BMC VNIC.
source_snapshot.criteria: Exactly UBB plus OAM0-7 return Health=OK, HealthRollup=OK and State=Enabled when the driver is loaded.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES and loops all nine objects, but uses plaintext sshpass, disabled host verification, fixed HTTP/-k and unconditionally modprobes without response identity/schema checks.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; requires protected endpoint/schema, physical nine-object map, driver-load approval and complete per-object health/freshness evidence.

old_problem: Fixed IP/resource names are not mapped to physical UBB/OAM modules; schema/freshness and absent-state semantics are undefined. The loop may hide mixed HTTP/JSON failures, and loading amdgpu is a state-changing device binding that DeepSeek treats as harmless. Source and DeepSeek use insecure access and log clearing.
disposition_reason: The expected nine-object matrix and exact Health/HealthRollup/State values are explicit. Endpoint, resource-to-module map, freshness and driver state are runtime Project Configuration. Loading amdgpu is conditional: if already correctly loaded, record it; if absent and required, obtain authorization and recovery. Each response is independently validated, logs preserved and no GPU reset/rebind is allowed.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2052, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2053 / Wistron-AMD SVM-01064-V003 / 58462c1c86fccaec was directly read from XLSX.
A successful shell loop exit cannot prove nine successful resources, so each UBB/OAM response needs its own HTTP status, JSON identity, timestamp, Health, HealthRollup and State result.
Health and HealthRollup are independent; State=Enabled is evaluated only under the signed driver/binding expectation, without forcing state through unload/rebind/reset.
`modprobe amdgpu` may bind devices or affect services; it is executed only if absent, required and explicitly approved with pre-state and recovery.
Protected TLS/session authentication replaces fixed HTTP/-k/plaintext SSH, and no BMC/host/GPU/SEL evidence is cleared.
No module query/load, GPU binding, Redfish request, authentication, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Identity-bound UBB plus eight-OAM Redfish health matrix
test_case.purpose: Verify one physical UBB and all eight mapped OAM modules independently report fresh Health=OK, HealthRollup=OK and the driver-appropriate State=Enabled through protected Redfish, without hiding a failed object or forcing GPU state.
required_package: Exact row-2052 variant plus SUT/BMC/UBB/OAM/GPU/kernel/driver identities
Approved protected VNIC endpoint/schema, TLS/authentication and one-UBB/eight-OAM resource-to-physical-module map
Health/HealthRollup/State semantics, expected absent behavior and freshness/cache rules
Conditional module-load authorization, impact/abort controls and recovery only if the approved prerequisite is absent
test_case.test_command: READ-MOSTLY WITH CONDITIONAL STATE GATE; preserve host/BMC/GPU/SEL logs and inspect module, binding, service/workload and GPU inventory. If amdgpu is already correctly loaded, do not reload it. If absent and the signed recipe requires it, obtain explicit approval, run one `modprobe amdgpu`, verify expected bindings/services and stop on error. Over protected authenticated TLS, independently GET the signed UBB resource and each of eight mapped OAM resources; record HTTP status, raw JSON, resource/physical identity, timestamps, Health, HealthRollup and State. Reconcile exactly nine unique fresh objects. Do not clear logs, unload/rebind/reset GPUs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly one mapped UBB and eight mapped OAM objects each return a complete fresh successful response for the correct physical module, with Health=OK, HealthRollup=OK and State=Enabled under the approved loaded-driver condition; GPU bindings/services remain healthy and no unexpected log appears.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the signed nine-object map, protected access, nine independently successful identity/freshness results, all three exact status fields and valid driver/service health. FAIL on missing/extra/duplicate/stale object, HTTP/schema/identity mismatch, any non-OK/non-Enabled field under the expected condition, driver/binding/service error or new critical log. Missing map/semantics/approval is NOT READY; partial loop success cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Inspect first; load amdgpu only if absent, required and explicitly approved with no conflicting workload and a recovery path.
Never unload, rebind or reset GPUs to force Enabled; preserve the observed failure state.
Use protected TLS/credentials and exact mapped resources; no fixed-IP/resource assumption.
Stop on module/service/GPU error, missing/stale object or non-OK status; no log clearing or automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash and full SUT/BMC/UBB/OAM/GPU identity/map
Conditional module-load approval/command/exit and post-binding evidence, or proof no load was needed
Nine raw responses with HTTP outcomes, resource IDs, physical mapping and timestamps
Nine-row Health/HealthRollup/State/freshness matrix plus missing/extra/duplicate analysis
Unexpected-log/no-clear/no-rebind/no-retry audit, recovery state and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On module/binding/service failure or any bad/missing/stale resource, stop and preserve raw module/GPU/Redfish/log state. Do not unload/rebind/reset or repeat queries to change the result. If the authorized module load caused impact, invoke the approved service/driver recovery under human control; close sessions and rotate exposed credentials.

source_conflict.reason: A signed physical nine-resource map and conditional driver gate replace fixed insecure assumptions, unconditional modprobe and incomplete loop semantics while preserving every source criterion.

blocked.reason: The health matrix, driver boundary, verdict and recovery are complete; endpoint/map/freshness and conditional approval are runtime Project inputs.
